stories.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh

en.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's air defense forces destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Houthi militants toward Riyadh on Saturday morning. Coalition officials characterized the attack as part of an escalating pattern of Houthi strikes against civilian targets.

stories.title: Pakistan military says fixing Kabul ties rests with Taliban, rules out TTP talks

en.title: Pakistan military says fixing Kabul ties rests with Taliban, rules out TTP talks
en.summary: Pakistan's military stated that improving relations with Afghanistan depends on the Taliban preventing militants from launching cross-border attacks, while rejecting negotiations with the Pakistani Taliban and reserving the right to act in self-defense.

en.title: Coalition intercepts and destroys ballistic missile fired toward Riyadh
en.summary: A coalition backing Yemen's internationally-recognized government destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Houthis at Riyadh without reported damage, according to a coalition spokesperson.

stories.title: Mocha gripped by fear after Houthi takeover

en.title: Mocha gripped by fear after Houthi takeover
en.summary: Residents of Yemen's Mocha port city have halted their daily activities following a Houthi military seizure, with businesses closed and people staying home due to fear of retaliation.

en.summary: The UN Security Council condemned attacks by Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia and expressed solidarity with the kingdom's right to self-defense under international law.

stories.title: ‎Saudi banks issue nearly SAR 31B sukuk in 2026

en.title: Saudi banks issue nearly SAR 31B sukuk in 2026
en.summary: Saudi banks listed on TASI have issued sukuk worth approximately SAR 30.75 billion since early 2026, with various denominations and yields ranging between 6.15% and 6.625%.

en.title: Gold settles higher, posts weekly gain
en.summary: Gold prices rose on Friday, achieving their first weekly gain in four weeks as declining oil prices reduced inflation concerns. Investors who had bet against gold prices moved to cover their positions.

stories.title: ‎Moody’s: GCC Islamic banks to continue outpacing conventional peers

en.title: Moody's: GCC Islamic banks to continue outpacing conventional peers
en.summary: Islamic banks in the GCC region are expected to expand faster than conventional banks due to strong demand for Shariah-compliant financing and higher public-sector exposure. These banks are projected to maintain stronger credit metrics and potentially higher profitability than conventional counterparts.

en.title: Oil ends lower, records weekly loss
en.summary: Oil prices declined for a third consecutive session, posting their first weekly loss in three weeks amid monitoring of Middle East geopolitical developments. Limited shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and production constraints from regional conflicts have impacted global fuel supplies.

stories.title: ‎Alswaha discusses AI infrastructure expansion in Saudi Arabia with AWS, Microsoft

en.title: Alswaha discusses AI infrastructure expansion in Saudi Arabia with AWS, Microsoft
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's communications minister met with executives from AWS and Microsoft to discuss expanding the country's artificial intelligence infrastructure and computing capacity. Topics included accelerating development of an AI Zone and deploying advanced computing accelerators in the Kingdom.
